explicit-standalone-flag.description: Runs Angular's explicit-standalone-flag migration on the project's in-program (NgModule-declared) custom artifacts.

standalone-override-flag.description: Synchronizes the standalone flag of theme override artifacts with their related standard artifact.

ngx-translate18.description: Migrates custom code to the ngx-translate 17/18 breaking changes: TranslateService API renames and the removal of TranslateModule in favor of TranslatePipe and provideTranslateService.
